headline._read: every situation target was published CIRCULAR — i.e. INADMISSIBLE, its scores 'measuring the lookup, not the model' — on a firewall whose own `context_leaks = false` said the context carries nothing. The repaired firewall decides on balanced accuracy, whose floor is 1/n_class at any imbalance.
headline.what_this_does_NOT_say: nothing here says the situation heads WORK. It says the circularity firewall was not the instrument that retired them. The pre-registered primary comparison (the AP-based vs_head_ego contrast) is untouched.
